LanguageData.GrechkaFaction_Mills.label: Seven Mills Union
LanguageData.GrechkaFaction_Mills.description: Millers scattered across seven villages after the great grain elevator burned. They trade food and cloth and defend their caravans.
LanguageData.GrechkaFaction_Rescue.label: Zero Shift
LanguageData.GrechkaFaction_Rescue.description: Descendants of the grain elevator emergency crew. Their caravans include skilled medics and their settlements supply medicine.
LanguageData.GrechkaFaction_Artel.label: Last Nut Artel
LanguageData.GrechkaFaction_Artel.description: A small guild of master technicians. Every human member has intellectual skill 16–20, two professional skills 16–20 and T5 Grechka bionics. Masters have two replacements and foremen have three. Captives retain their implants when recruited.
LanguageData.GrechkaFaction_Bare.label: Barefoot Hundred
LanguageData.GrechkaFaction_Bare.description: War bands with T5 combat and movement chips. They fight naked and favor melee. Initially hostile, but peace can be negotiated.
LanguageData.GrechkaFaction_Post.label: Bureau of Unopened Parcels
LanguageData.GrechkaFaction_Post.description: Couriers of a postal service that outlived its state. Every courier carries a real T1–T3 lucky block which can be recovered as ordinary loot.
